paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Proportion of SDPA output values below threshold after gating (Left: 1e-2, Right: 1e-3). We also include sparsity measurements obtained by multiplying the average gating score with pre-gating hidden states.

annotations.annotation: 该折线图展示了在 1e-2 阈值下，SDPA 在不同层上输出的稀疏度比 (sparsity ratio)。x 轴标记为“层” （Layer)，使用线性刻度，范围从 0 到 20，间隔为 5。y 轴标记为“稀疏度” (sparsity ratio)，同样采用线性刻度，范围从 0.0 到 1.0，间隔为 0.2。图中有三条线。第一条线由蓝色虚线展示，表示“门控前的稀疏度” (sparsity ratio before gate)，起始值约为 1.0，向图的右侧逐渐下降至约 0.0。第二条以圆圈构成的橙色虚线表示“门控后的稀疏度” (sparsity ratio after gate)，起始值约为 1.0，到第 10 层时降至接近 0.1，之后略有上升和波动。第三条线是一条带有圆圈标记的绿色虚线，描绘了“平均门控后的稀疏度比” (sparsity ratio after average gate)，从大约 1.0 开始，更平稳地下降，到第 15 层时稳定在 0.1 附近，后续层中的波动也很小。

The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, using a threshold of 1e-2. The x-axis is labeled "Layer," and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22 with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," also employs a linear scale and spans from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Three lines are present in the plot. The blue dashed, which represents the "sparsity ratio before gate", begins at about 0.2 ratio at layer 0, reduces to almost 0.0 by layer 2 and stays relatively constant accross all layers. The orange dotted line, representing "sparsity ratio after gate," starts at about 1.0 ratio at later 0, reduces to about 0.2 by layer 14, and shows flactuations between 0.2 and 0.4 thereafter. The green dash-dot line, representing the "sparsity ratio after average gate," starts at roughly 1.0, decreasing more smoothly to about 0.17 ration by layer 14 and then remains relatively stable with slight fluctuations thereafter.

Die Abbildung ist ein Liniendiagramm die das Sparsity-Verhältnis der SDPA Ausgabe über verschiedene Ebenen hinweg unter einem Schwellenwert von 1e-2. Die horizontale Achse ist mit "Ebene" beschriftet und verwendet eine lineare Skala von 0 bis 20 mit Teilstrichen in Abständen von 5. Die vertikale Achse ist mit "Sparsity-Verhältnis" beschriftet und verwendet ebenfalls eine lineare Skala und reicht von 0,0 bis 1,0 mit Teilstrichen in Abständen von 0,2. Das Diagramm enthält drei Linien in unterschiedlichen Farben. Die blaue gestrichelte Linie zeigt das "Sparsity-Verhältnis vor Gate" und beginnt bei einem Verhältnis von ca. 0.2 in Ebene 0 und fällt bis Layer 2 ab auf ein Verhältnis von 0,05. Bis Ebene 25 bleibt die Linie konstant auf ungefähr 0,05. Die orange gepunktete Linie stellt das "Sparsity-Verhältnis nach Gate" dar, das in Ebene 0 bei etwas 1,0 beginnt und bis Ebene 12 abfällt auf etwas 0,2. Ab dann hält sich die Linie zwischen 0,2 und 0,4 mit leichten Anstiegen und Schwankungen. Die grün gestrichelte Linie stellt das "Spärlichkeitsverhältnis nach dem Durchschnittsgate" dar und beginnt in Ebene 0 bei 1,0, fällt von dort ab bis Ebene 12 auf etwa 0,15 und bleibt dann bis Ebene 25 konstant. Eine Legende ist in der rechten oberen Ecke und zeigt die Linien, die Farbe und die jeweilige Bezeichnung.

Фигурата е линейна графика, показваща коефициента на разреденост на изхода на SDPA на различни нива под праг от 1e-2. Хоризонталната ос е обозначена като „Ниво“ и използва линейна скала от 0 до 20 с отметки на интервали от 5. Вертикалната ос е обозначена като „Коефициент на разреденост“ и също използва линейна скала и варира от 0,0 до 1,0 с отметки на интервали от 0,2. Графиката съдържа три линии в различни цветове. Синята пунктирана линия показва „коефициента на разреденост преди портата“ и започва от съотношение приблизително 0,2 в слой 0 и намалява до съотношение 0,05 в слой 2. До ниво 25 линията остава постоянна на приблизително 0,05. Оранжевата пунктирана линия представлява „коефициентът на разреденост след портата“, който започва от около 1,0 на ниво 0 и намалява до около 0,2 на ниво 12. От този момент нататък линията остава между 0,2 и 0,4 с леки увеличения и колебания. Зелената пунктирана линия представлява „коефициентът на разреденост след средната порта“ и започва от 1,0 на ниво 0, намалява оттам до около 0,15 на ниво 12 и след това остава постоянна до ниво 25. Легендата е в горния десен ъгъл и показва линиите, цвета и съответния етикет.

The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, under a threshold of 1e-2. The x-axis is labeled "Layer," using a linear scale ranging from 0 to 25, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," also uses a linear scale and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, featuring tick labels at intervals of 0.2. There are three lines in the plot. The first line, represented by a blue dashed line, depicts the "sparsity ratio before gate" and begins at around 0.2, decreasing steadily to approximately 0.01 towards the right of the plot. The orange dotted line with circle markers represents the "sparsity ratio after gate," starting at about 1.0 and reducing to near 0.3 by layer 10, with slight increases and fluctuations thereafter. The third line, a green dash-dot line with dashed and circular markers, shows the "sparsity ratio after average gate," beginning at roughly 1.0, decreasing more smoothly, and stabilizing near 0.1 by layer 15 with minor fluctuations in subsequent layers. A legend is provided in the bottom right corner of the plot which identifies three lines and also provides their average sparsity ratio.

The first line, represented by a blue dashed line shows the "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03" and begins at Sparsity ratio around 0.2 at Layer 0, decreasing sharply to approximately 0.03 at Layer 3, and maintaining steady decrease towards the right of the plot till Layer 24. The orange dotted line represents the "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44" starting at Sparsity Ratio about 1.0 and reducing sharply to near 0.2 by layer 14, with slight fluctuations thereafter til 19 and higher fluctuations thereafter ending around Sparsity 0.4 at Layer 24. The third line, a green dash-dot line with no markers, depicts the "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33" beginning at Sparsity Ratio of about 1.0, reducing sharply to near 0.2 by layer 14, with slight fluctuations thereafter ending around Sparsity 0.05 at Layer 24. The blue dashed line doesn't intersect with the other two lines, whereas the orange dotted line and green dash-dot line intersect multiple times at the beginning. A legend is located top right of the plot describing lines and their representation.
